subject: East to West Alita 22NFT (2026 model year) and the 2027 22NF designation
note: The VIN-specific yellow sticker overrides every published weight. UVW and CCC were not published. Null values are unknown, not zero.

tow_capacity_lb.note: Published tow capacity. Not a tongue rating. At a coach loaded to GVWR, GCWR minus GVWR is 2500 lb, which is below this 4000 lb figure.

water_lb_per_gal.note: East to West cargo-capacity definition on the 22NF floorplan page.

chassis_frame_end_behind_axle_in.note: 2023 MY Ford Transit BEMM: rear axle to end of frame, not including the frame adapter, listed with the EL-LWB 178 in chassis. This is the chassis frame, not the finished coach body.

max_frame_extension_el_lwb_in.note: Maximum rear frame extension for the 178 in EL-LWB column in the 2023 BEMM extract.

frame_ctc_in.note: Kelderman drawing 10005559 labels CTC Frame 35.400 in for a 2014+ Transit 350HD DRW cab chassis and cutaway. Center-to-center, not the inside clear gap. Not confirmed for this coach.
